valid_ramps.name: Valid Case 1
valid_ramps.description: Case 1: Minimum width single wheelchair ramp, short length, gentle slope

valid_ramps.name: Valid Case 2
valid_ramps.description: Case 2: Two people width ramp, max length with platform at 10m

valid_ramps.name: Valid Case 3
valid_ramps.description: Case 3: Platform size using alternative dimensions transverse 1.4m, longitudinal 1.7m

valid_ramps.name: Valid Case 4 - Platform at 10m, narrow ramp
valid_ramps.description: Case 4: Ramp with intermediate platform exactly at 10m, width 0.9m (wheelchair), gentle slope

valid_ramps.name: Valid Case 5 - Multiple platforms
valid_ramps.description: Case 5: Ramp with multiple platforms every 10m for longer ramp, width 1.5m

valid_ramps.name: Valid Case 6 - Short ramp no platform needed
valid_ramps.description: Case 6: Ramp with slope slightly less than 8%, no platforms because length < 10m

valid_ramps.name: Valid Case 7 - Alternate platform size and width
valid_ramps.description: Case 7: Ramp with alternate platform size transverse 1.4m, longitudinal 1.7m, width 1.0m

valid_ramps.name: Valid Case 8 - Minimal kerb height
valid_ramps.description: Case 8: Minimal kerb height exactly at 10 cm with wheelchair width ramp and slope 8%

invalid_ramps.name: Invalid Case 1 - Height difference too high
invalid_ramps.description: Height difference exceeds 3.20 m, so not accessible.

invalid_ramps.name: Invalid Case 2 - Ramp too narrow for wheelchair
invalid_ramps.description: Ramp width less than minimum 0.90 m required for wheelchair.

invalid_ramps.name: Invalid Case 3 - Ramp too narrow for two people
invalid_ramps.description: Ramp width less than 1.50 m required to allow passage of two people.

invalid_ramps.name: Invalid Case 4 - No platform after 10m
invalid_ramps.description: Missing horizontal platform every 10 m when doorways are present.

invalid_ramps.name: Invalid Case 5 - Kerb missing on open side
invalid_ramps.description: Kerb less than 0.10 m high on non-filled parapet side.

invalid_ramps.name: Invalid Case 6 - Ramp slope exceeds 8%
invalid_ramps.description: Ramp slope exceeds maximum 8% allowed for accessibility.
